title: Templates
description: Manage WhatsApp message templates approved by Meta
emptyNotConnected: Connect WhatsApp from settings first, then sync templates or add from Meta library.
emptyConnected: Sync from Meta, or browse ready-made templates (orders, shipping, payments...) and add them to your organization.
connectToEnable: to enable sync and template sending.
archiveDescription: The template will be archived and unavailable for sending.
resubmitDescription: The template will be sent to Meta for review again.
newPageDescription: Create a new WhatsApp message template
formCardDescription: Enter template details to submit to Meta for review
libraryPageDescription: Browse ready-made templates (orders, shipping, payments...) and add them to your organization
connectToBrowse: to browse and add templates from Meta library.
librarySteps: Pick a template → Add to your account → Meta reviews it (usually minutes) →
libraryStepsEnd: → When status is {approved} you can send from Inbox.
noLibraryDescription: Try changing language filters or search. Some templates are only available in specific languages.
libraryResultsHint: Showing first 50 results — use language filters or search to narrow results.

form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only
form.categoryHint: Determines how Meta classifies the template
form.bodyHint: You can include variables like '{{1}}' to fill when sending
form.buttonsHint: Add up to 3 buttons — quick reply, URL, or phone number
form.noButtons: No buttons added yet — click Add button to add an interactive button
form.buttonUrlHint: You can use '{{1}}' as a dynamic variable at the end of the URL

picker.title: Send template
picker.description: Select language then approved template to send.
picker.noTemplatesWaba: No Meta-approved templates for this account — add from Meta library then sync.
picker.noTemplates: No send-ready templates. Add from Meta library then sync after approval.

addLibrary.title: Add template to WhatsApp account
addLibrary.description: Template is sent to Meta for review. After approval, sync from my templates page then send from Inbox.
addLibrary.selectFromLibrary: Select a template from the library
addLibrary.authTemplate: Authentication (OTP) template — added with copy-code button as Meta requires.
addLibrary.unsupportedButtons: This template has unsupported buttons ({types}). Choose a template with URL, Phone, or OTP buttons only.

validation.nameFormat: Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only
validation.variableAtStartHeader: Header cannot start with a variable — add static text before '{{1}}'
validation.variableAtEndHeader: Header cannot end with a variable — add static text after '{{1}}'
validation.variableAtStartBody: Body cannot start with a variable — add static text before '{{1}}'
validation.variableAtEndBody: Body cannot end with a variable — add static text after '{{1}}'
validation.buttonTextMax: Button text must not exceed 25 characters
validation.buttonUrlFormat: URL must start with http:// or https://
validation.buttonUrlMax: Only one URL button is allowed
validation.buttonPhoneMax: Only one phone button is allowed

statusHints.PENDING: Pending Meta review — sync later after approval
statusHints.REJECTED: Rejected — edit the template or choose another

toast.addedApproved: Template added and approved — you can send it now
toast.addedPending: Template added to Meta — wait for approval then sync from my templates page
